Keys

  
→SpacePgDnnext step (press during an animation to finish it)

  
Shift+→next step without animation

  
←PgUpprevious step (exact previous state)

  
Rreplay the current step

  
O / Escoverview: jump to any scene

  
Npresenter notes window (share only this tab)

  
Bblack screen

  
Llaser pointer (big red dot follows the mouse)

  
Ffull screen

  
Shide / show progress bar and counter

  
Home / Endfirst / last scene

  
Print / PDFopen with ?print at the end of the address, then print to PDF (one page per scene)
